title: Reddit stock plunges 29% after weak outlook, wrapping its worst day ever
summary: On October 30, 2026, Reddit's stock experienced a significant decline, plummeting by 29% following the company's announcement of disappointing sales projections for the fourth quarter. This downturn marked the worst day in the company's history, reflecting investor concerns over its future performance. Additionally, Reddit revealed plans to implement a login requirement for users to access content, which may further impact user engagement and revenue.
